errors.explanation: The pronoun 'it' (the contract or agreement) is rendered as 'el mismo', which is stilted and ambiguous. 'incumple de forma sustancial' is more natural, with the object as a clitic ('lo incumple') or an explicit noun such as 'el contrato'. In Spanish legal usage, 'incumplir sustancialmente' is acceptable, and 'el mismo' is a common legalese calque, so the issue is only stylistic.

The source says the other party "becomes insolvent", which describes a state of insolvency. The translation says it "declares itself insolvent", which implies a formal act or declaration. A closer rendering would be "cae en insolvencia", "pasa a ser insolvente" or "se vuelve insolvente". In a contract the difference matters somewhat, because insolvency can occur without any declaration. The meaning is largely preserved, so the severity is minor.

In Spanish legal and contractual language, "force majeure" is usually rendered as "un evento de fuerza mayor" or "un supuesto de fuerza mayor". "Caso de fuerza mayor" is also acceptable and widely used, so the meaning is preserved. The choice of "caso" over "evento" is only a slight register and terminology deviation from the source's "event".

src: Explore our new range of 10-inch Android devices with stunning displays.
This tablet is perfect for streaming and gaming.
tgt: Explora nuestra nueva gama de dispositivos Android de 10 pulgadas con pantallas impresionantes.
Esta tableta es perfecta para ver contenido en streaming y jugar.

src: Join the legendary vinyl collectors' club.
Every record in our catalog is pressed on 180-gram vinyl.
tgt: Únete al legendario club de coleccionistas de vinilos.
Cada disco de nuestro catálogo está prensado en vinilo de 180 gramos.

src: The cardholder authorizes the merchant to debit the account.
Any charge not disputed within 30 days is deemed accepted.
tgt: El titular de la tarjeta autoriza al comerciante a cargar el importe en la cuenta.
Cualquier cargo que no se impugne en un plazo de 30 días se considerará aceptado.

src: The defendant was arrested on March 3.
The court dismissed the charge for lack of evidence.
tgt: El acusado fue detenido el 3 de marzo.
El tribunal desestimó el cargo por falta de pruebas.

src: Take one tablet twice daily with food.
Do not crush the tablet before swallowing it.
tgt: Tome un comprimido dos veces al día con الطعام.
No triture el comprimido antes de tragárselo.

errors.explanation: The word for 'food' is left in Arabic (الطعام) instead of Spanish 'comida' or 'alimentos'. A Spanish-speaking reader may not understand the instruction to take the tablet with food. This is a script and language mix-up in the Spanish text.

src: The glucose meter must be recharged before first use.
Connect the device to the wall outlet until the charge indicator turns green.
tgt: El medidor de glucosa debe recargarse antes del primer uso.
Conecte el dispositivo a la toma de corriente hasta que el indicador de carga se ponga verde.

src: Export
To save your report, click Export.
Then choose a folder and click Export again.
tgt: Exportar
Para guardar tu informe, haz clic en Exportar.
A continuación, elige una carpeta y vuelve a hacer clic en Exportar.

src: Settings
Open the Settings menu and select Privacy.
You can return to Settings at any time.
tgt: Ajustes
Abre el menú Ajustes y selecciona Privacidad.
Puedes volver a Ajustes en cualquier momento.

src: Add to Cart
Found something you love? Click Add to Cart and check out in seconds.
Remember: items are only reserved after you click Add to Cart.
tgt: Añadir al carrito
¿Has encontrado algo que te encanta? Haz clic en Añadir al carrito y completa tu compra en segundos.
Recuerda: los artículos solo se reservan después de hacer clic en Añadir al carrito.

src: I Accept
By clicking I Accept, you agree to these Terms of Service.
If you do not agree, do not click I Accept.
tgt: Acepto
Al hacer clic en Acepto, usted acepta estas Condiciones del servicio.
Si no está de acuerdo, no haga clic en Acepto.

src: Manage Cookies
You may change your preferences at any time by selecting Manage Cookies in the footer.
Selecting Manage Cookies does not delete cookies already stored.
tgt: Gestionar cookies
Puede cambiar sus preferencias en cualquier momento seleccionando Gestionar cookies en el pie de página.
Seleccionar Gestionar cookies no elimina las cookies ya almacenadas.

src: Start
To begin your infusion, press Start on the pump display.
To pause, press Stop. To resume, press Start again.
tgt: Inicio
Para iniciar la infusión, pulse Start en la pantalla de la bomba.
Para pausar, pulse Stop. Para reanudar, pulse de nuevo Start.

errors.explanation: The button label "Start" is left in English. This may be intentional if the pump interface is displayed in English, but if the device UI is localized it should be "Inicio" or "Iniciar". The label is also not marked, for example with quotation marks or bold, to show it is a literal on-screen label. The meaning is still understandable, so the issue is minor.
UI button label left in English. If the Spanish interface localizes it as 'Detener' or 'Parar', the text should use that label. If the interface really displays 'Stop', this is not an error.
UI button label left in English. If the Spanish interface localizes it as 'Iniciar' or 'Inicio', the text should use that label. If the interface really displays 'Start', this is not an error.
